name: Fast Browser
description: Jev-powered browser agent for PI-Desktop: dynamic indexed action space, one TypeSafe request per decision, work-panel browser via CDP. Tools: jev_observe, jev_act, jev_run, jev_wait, jev_cancel.
author: local

agentTools.name: jev_observe
agentTools.description: Observe the work-panel browser page and return the Jev-style numbered element table (index, role, label, value, operations) plus page text preview. Call after navigate.

agentTools.name: jev_act
agentTools.description: Execute one observed action on the work-panel browser: CLICK / TYPE_TEXT / SELECT / SCROLL / WAIT. Pass an element index from jev_observe (e.g. "3", "6:2") or a control id ("scroll_down", "wait"), with text for TYPE_TEXT. Re-checks page freshness before acting.

agentTools.name: jev_run
agentTools.description: Run the full Jev browser-agent loop on the work-panel browser: navigate to url, then observe -> Jev decision (TypeSafe API) -> execute -> repeat until DONE/BLOCKED/step budget. Returns immediately with a runId; poll with jev_wait.

agentTools.name: jev_wait
agentTools.description: Wait for a jev_run run to finish or time out. Returns current status, step history, and the latest element table.

agentTools.name: jev_cancel
agentTools.description: Cancel a running jev_run loop and release the work-panel browser.

settings.title: TypeSafe API Key
settings.description: TypeSafe API key for Jev decision routing (https://api.typesafe.ai). Required for jev_run.

settings.title: TypeSafe Model
settings.description: TypeSafe model id used for routing decisions.

settings.title: Max Steps
settings.description: Hard step budget per run (jev-ultrafast default 60).
